• Offriamo un trattamento moderno per pazienti con patologie di tutto lo spettro della psichiatria. Assumono attività psichiatriche e psicoterapeutiche nelle offerte di trattamento ospedaliero, diurno e ambulatoriale sotto supervisione di un medico di grado superiore Laurea in medicina umana (CH, UE o AELS) Interesse per la psichiatria e la psicoterapia in tutta la sua diversità Piacere di lavorare con persone affette da malattie mentali nel team multiprofessionale Alto impegno, creatività e buone conoscenze del tedesco I servizi psichiatrici di Turgovia (PDT) sono costituiti dalla clinica psichiatrica di Münsterlingen, dalla psichiatria ambulatoriale per adulti e dal servizio psichiatrico per bambini e adolescenti. Le PDT fanno parte dell'azienda di successo Spital Thurgau AG con oltre 4.100 dipendenti. Le sedi aziendali si trovano a Münsterlingen, Weinfelden, Kreuzlingen, Frauenfeld e Romanshorn.

descriptionByLocale.en:
For our Psychiatric Clinic in Münsterlingen and the outpatient adult psychiatry with clarification and triage points, outpatient clinics, day clinics and upcoming offers at the locations Münsterlingen, Kreuzlingen, Romanshorn, Weinfelden and in the Cantonal Hospital Frauenfeld we are constantly looking for assistant physicians and psychotherapy 100% or part-time
• We offer a modern treatment for patients with disease images from the entire spectrum of psychiatrics. They take over psychiatric and psychotherapeutic activities in stationary, day-clinical and outpatient treatment offerings under supervision completed studies in human medicine (CH, EU or EFTA State) Interest in psychiatry and psychotherapy in all its diversity Joy in working with mentally ill people in the multi-professional team High commitment, creativity and good German skills The psychiatric services Thurgau (PDT) consist of the Psychiatric Clinic Münsterlingen, the outpatient adult psychiatry and the child and youth psychiatry service. PDT is part of the successful Spital Thurgau AG with over 4'100 employees. Company locations are located in Münsterlingen, Weinfelden, Kreuzlingen, Frauenfeld and Romanshorn.
• We offer attractive working environments, interdisciplinary cooperation and targeted development opportunities. Together with the Psychiatric Clinic Münsterlingen (PKM), the outpatient adult psychiatry (AEP) is responsible for the psychiatric and psychotherapeutic care of the adult population in Thurgau. We treat more than 7,500 patients each year and offer specialized outpatient, looking and day-clinical offers in Münsterlingen, Weinfelden, Kreuzlingen, Frauenfeld and Romanshorn. AEP, as part of Thurgau's psychiatry services, is a highly attractive employer for an esteemed culture combined with excellent training and training. Ils prennent en charge les activités psychiatriques et psychothérapeutiques dans les services de soins fixes, cliniques de jour et ambulatoires sous surveillance études réalisées en médecine humaine (CH, UE ou État de l'AELE) Intérêt pour la psychiatrie et la psychothérapie dans toute sa diversité La joie de travailler avec des malades mentaux dans l'équipe multiprofessionnelle Haut engagement, créativité et bonnes compétences allemandes Les services psychiatriques Thurgau (PDT) comprennent la clinique psychiatrique Münsterlingen, la psychiatrie pour adultes ambulatoires et le service de psychiatrie pour enfants et jeunes. PDT fait partie de Spital Thurgau AG avec plus de 4'100 employés. L'entreprise est située à Münsterlingen, Weinfelden, Kreuzlingen, Frauenfeld et Romanshorn.
• Nous offrons des environnements de travail attrayants, une coopération interdisciplinaire et des possibilités de développement ciblées. Avec la clinique psychiatrique Münsterlingen (PKM), la psychiatrie ambulatoire (AEP) est responsable des soins psychiatriques et psychothérapeutiques de la population adulte de Thurgau. Nous traitons plus de 7 500 patients chaque année et offrons des offres de soins ambulatoires spécialisés, de recherche et de jour clinique à Münsterlingen, Weinfelden, Kreuzlingen, Frauenfeld et Romanshorn. L'AEP, dans le cadre des services de psychiatrie de Thurgau, est un employeur très attrayant pour une culture estimée combinée à une excellente formation.
